blueprint.description:
Main Notes:
- Stack Size 16 output alternating between sides
- Double swing inputs
- Fully sleeps when idle
- Must maintain full backpressure on lithium plates at all times to avoid inserter deadlock
- Fixes previous version clock not being compatible with Factorio 2.1+

- designed by abucnasty & geist
